critical.issue: Backend TrashItemCreate requires device_id on EVERY item, but frontend api.addTrash (src/lib/api.ts:77-83) only sends device_id at the wrapper level. Returns 422 'Field required body.items.0.device_id'. Compress & Offload screens catch the error silently so originals are never persisted to Trash despite the success toast/summary being shown.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: schema mismatch between backend and frontend for POST /api/trash. Backend Pydantic model `TrashItemCreate` declares `device_id: str` as a REQUIRED field on every item. Frontend helper `api.addTrash` in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.ts:77-83 constructs the payload as `{device_id: id, items: [...items]}` where each raw item only has {name, kind, size_bytes, thumb_uri, origin} — missing device_id. FastAPI returns 422 with `body.items.0.device_id: Field required`. Both compress.tsx (line ~81) and offload.tsx (line ~76) wrap the call in `try { await api.addTrash(...) } catch {}` so the request failure is invisible; execution continues to haptics.success(), setSaved()/setPhotos(), toast(...), giving a false success UI. Reproduction: curl -X POST $BASE/api/trash -d '{"device_id":"x","items":[{"name":"a","kind":"photo","size_bytes":1}]}' → 422. Fix option A (backend, recommended): change `class TrashItemCreate` to make `device_id: Optional[str] = None` and inside `add_trash` do `t = TrashItem(**{**item.dict(), "device_id": payload.device_id})`. Fix option B (frontend): `body: JSON.stringify({ device_id: id, items: items.map(it => ({...it, device_id: id})) })`.
